component.name: JellyfinTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "go" end sub
sub go() xfer = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") xfer.SetUrl(m.top.url) xfer.AddHeader("Authorization", "MediaBrowser Token=""" + m.top.key + """") xfer.EnableEncodings(true) r = xfer.GetToString() if r = invalid then r = "" m.top.result = r end sub
